title: पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 15 · Ashvatthaman and the Pandya king

summary.en: Dhritarashtra recalls Sanjaya's praise of the Pandya hero and asks how he fought. Sanjaya describes the Pandya king's great feats against the Kaurava army and how he came to meet Drona's son.
summary.kn: ಸಂಜಯ ಮೊದಲು ಹೊಗಳಿದ ಪಾಂಡ್ಯ ವೀರನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ನೆನೆದು ಅವನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿದನೆಂದು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಾಂಡ್ಯರಾಜ ಕೌರವ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ತೋರಿದ ಮಹಾ ಸಾಹಸವನ್ನೂ ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮನನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದ್ದನ್ನೂ ಸಂಜಯ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र संजय द्वारा पहले प्रशंसित पाण्ड्य वीर को याद कर पूछते हैं कि वह कैसे लड़ा। संजय पाण्ड्य राजा के कौरव सेना के विरुद्ध महान कर्मों और द्रोणपुत्र से उसकी भिड़ंत का वर्णन करते हैं।
summary.te: సంజయుడు ముందు పొగిడిన పాండ్య వీరుని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు గుర్తు చేసి అతడు ఎలా పోరాడాడని అడుగుతాడు. పాండ్య రాజు కౌరవసేనపై చేసిన మహా కార్యాలను, ద్రోణపుత్రుని ఎదుర్కొన్న తీరును సంజయుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: சஞ்சயன் முன்பு புகழ்ந்த பாண்டிய வீரனை நினைவுகூர்ந்து அவன் எவ்வாறு போரிட்டான் என்று த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்கிறான். கௌரவப் படைக்கு எதிரான பாண்டிய மன்னனின் வீரச் செயல்களையும் துரோணர் மகனைச் சந்தித்ததையும் சஞ்சயன் விவரிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡ്യവീരനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള സഞ്ജയന്റെ പ്രശംസ ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ഓർക്കുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹം എങ്ങനെ പൊരുതി എന്ന് ചോദിക്കുന്നു. പാണ്ഡ്യരാജാവ് കൗരവസേനയ്ക്കെതിരെ നടത്തിയ മഹത്തായ പോരാട്ടവും ദ്രോണപുത്രനെ അദ്ദേഹം എങ്ങനെ നേരിട്ടു എന്നതും സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.15; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
प्रोक्तस्त्वया पूर्वमेव प्रवीरो लोकविश्रुतः ।
न त्वस्य कर्म संग्रामे त्वया संजय कीर्तितम् ॥

meaning.en: You spoke earlier of a hero famed in the world, Sanjaya, but you have not told me his deeds in the battle.

verses.text:
तस्य विस्तरतो ब्रूहि प्रवीरस्याद्य विक्रमम् ।
शिक्षां प्रभावं वीर्यं च प्रमाणं दर्पमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Tell me in full today the prowess, training, power, valour, measure and pride of that hero.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
द्रोणभीष्मकृपद्रौणिकर्णार्जुनजनार्दनान् ।
समाप्तविद्यान्धनुषि श्रेष्ठान्यान्मन्यसे युधि ॥

meaning.en: Those whom you consider the best in battle, Drona, Bhishma, Kripa, Drona's son, Karna, Arjuna and Janardana, all of complete learning in archery,

verses.text:
तुल्यता कर्णभीष्माभ्यामात्मनो येन दृश्यते ।
वासुदेवार्जुनाभ्यां च न्यूनतां नात्मनीच्छति ॥

meaning.en: with these he sees himself as equal, with Karna and Bhishma, and he does not wish to admit that he is lesser than Vasudeva and Arjuna.

verses.text:
स पाण्ड्यो नृपतिश्रेष्ठः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
कर्णस्यानीकमवधीत्परिभूत इवान्तकः ॥

meaning.en: That Pandya, best of kings, foremost of all weapon-bearers, struck down Karna's army like Death enraged.

verses.text:
तदुदीर्णरथाश्वं च पत्तिप्रवरकुञ्जरम् ।
कुलालचक्रवद्भ्रान्तं पाण्ड्येनाधिष्ठितं बलम् ॥

meaning.en: His force, with chariots and horses mounted and with fine foot-soldiers and elephants, whirled like a potter's wheel, held by the Pandya.

verses.text:
व्यश्वसूतध्वजरथान्विप्रविद्धायुधान्रिपून् ।
सम्यगस्तैः शरैः पाण्ड्यो वायुर्मेघानिवाक्षिपत् ॥

meaning.en: With well-aimed arrows the Pandya scattered the enemy, their horses, charioteers, banners and chariots gone and weapons flung away, as the wind scatters clouds.

verses.text:
द्विरदान्प्रहतप्रोथान्विपताकध्वजायुधान् ।
सपादरक्षानवधीद्वज्रेणारीनिवारिहा ॥

meaning.en: Elephants with trunks and snouts struck, with flags, banners and weapons gone, with their foot-guards, he killed like a slayer of foes with a thunderbolt.

verses.text:
सशक्तिप्रासतूणीरानश्वारोहान्हयानपि ।
पुलिन्दखशबाह्लीकान्निषादान्ध्रकतङ्गणान् ॥

meaning.en: He took the lives of horsemen with spears, javelins and quivers, and horses, Pulindas, Khashas, Bahlikas, Nishadas, Andhras, Tanganas,

verses.text:
दाक्षिणात्यांश्च भोजांश्च क्रूरान्संग्रामकर्कशान् ।
विशस्त्रकवचान्बाणैः कृत्वा पाण्ड्योऽकरोद्व्यसून् ॥

meaning.en: southerners and Bhojas, cruel and hard in war, having made them weaponless and armourless with arrows.

verses.text:
चतुरङ्गं बलं बाणैर्निघ्नन्तं पाण्ड्यमाहवे ।
दृष्ट्वा द्रौणिरसंभ्रान्तमसंभ्रान्ततरोऽभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Pandya killing the four-limbed force with arrows in the battle, calm, Drona's son, calmer still, advanced against him.

verses.text:
आभाष्य चैनं मधुरमभि नृत्यन्नभीतवत् ।
प्राह प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः स्मितपूर्वं समाह्वयन् ॥

meaning.en: Greeting him sweetly, as though dancing, fearless, that best of fighters called to him with a smile:

verses.text:
राजन्कमलपत्राक्ष प्रधानायुधवाहन ।
वज्रसंहननप्रख्य प्रधानबलपौरुष ॥

meaning.en: "King, lotus-eyed, with the best weapons and mounts, resembling the thunderbolt in frame, foremost in strength and manliness,

verses.text:
मुष्टिश्लिष्टायुधाभ्यां च व्यायताभ्यां महद्धनुः ।
दोर्भ्यां विस्फारयन्भासि महाजलदवद्भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: you shine like a great cloud, stretching your great bow with your two long arms that grip it firm.

verses.text:
शरवर्षैर्महावेगैरमित्रानभिवर्षतः ।
मदन्यं नानुपश्यामि प्रतिवीरं तवाहवे ॥

meaning.en: As you rain on your enemies with showers of arrows of great speed, I see no rival hero of yours in the battle except myself.

verses.text:
रथद्विरदपत्त्यश्वानेकः प्रमथसे बहून् ।
मृगसंघानिवारण्ये विभीर्भीमबलो हरिः ॥

meaning.en: You alone crush many chariots, elephants, foot-soldiers and horses, as a fearless lion of Bhima's strength crushes herds of deer in the forest.

verses.text:
महता रथघोषेण दिवं भूमिं च नादयन् ।
वर्षान्ते सस्यहा पीथो भाभिरापूरयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: With the great rumble of your chariot sounding heaven and earth, you shine as if filling everything with radiance at the end of the rains.

verses.text:
संस्पृशानः शरांस्तीक्ष्णांस्तूणादाशीविषोपमान् ।
मयैवैकेन युध्यस्व त्र्यम्बकेणान्धको यथा ॥

meaning.en: Taking sharp arrows from your quiver like venomous snakes, fight with me alone, as Andhaka did with Tryambaka."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रहरेति च ताडितः ।
कर्णिना द्रोणतनयं विव्याध मलयध्वजः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, he said "So be it" and, "Strike!" and, struck, the one with the Malaya banner pierced Drona's son with a barbed arrow.

verses.text:
मर्मभेदिभिरत्युग्रैर्बाणैरग्निशिखोपमैः ।
स्मयन्नभ्यहनद्द्रौणिः पाण्ड्यमाचार्यसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son, best of teachers, smiling, struck the Pandya with very fierce arrows, bone-piercing and like flames of fire.

verses.text:
ततो नवापरांस्तीक्ष्णान्नाराचान्कङ्कवाससः ।
गत्या दशम्या संयुक्तानश्वत्थामा व्यवासृजत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Ashvatthama loosed nine other sharp iron arrows with heron feathers, which flew with a tenfold motion.

verses.text:
तेषां पञ्चाच्छिनत्पाण्ड्यः पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः ।
चत्वारोऽभ्याहनन्वाहानाशु ते व्यसवोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandya cut five of them with five sharp arrows; four struck his horses and they quickly lost their lives.

verses.text:
अथ द्रोणसुतस्येषूंस्तांश्छित्त्वा निशितैः शरैः ।
धनुर्ज्यां विततां पाण्ड्यश्चिच्छेदादित्यवर्चसः ॥

meaning.en: Then, cutting those arrows of Drona's son with sharp arrows, the Pandya, bright as the sun, cut his stretched bowstring.

verses.text:
विज्यं धनुरथाधिज्यं कृत्वा द्रौणिरमित्रहा ।
ततः शरसहस्राणि प्रेषयामास पाण्ड्यतः ।
इषुसंबाधमाकाशमकरोद्दिश एव च ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son, slayer of foes, re-strung the unstrung bow and sent thousands of arrows at the Pandya, making the sky and the quarters crowded with arrows.

verses.text:
ततस्तानस्यतः सर्वान्द्रौणेर्बाणान्महात्मनः ।
जानानोऽप्यक्षयान्पाण्ड्योऽशातयत्पुरुषर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: Though he knew they were inexhaustible, the Pandya, best of men, shattered all those arrows shot by the great-souled son of Drona.

verses.text:
प्रहितांस्तान्प्रयत्नेन छित्त्वा द्रौणेरिषूनरिः ।
चक्ररक्षौ ततस्तस्य प्राणुदन्निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Having cut the enemy's arrows that were loosed with effort, he drove away with sharp arrows the two guards of his wheels.

verses.text:
अथारेर्लाघवं दृष्ट्वा मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकः ।
प्रास्यद्द्रोणसुतो बाणान्वृष्टिं पूषानुजो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Then, seeing the enemy's lightness of hand, Drona's son, bending his bow into a circle, loosed arrows like a rain, like Pusha's younger brother.

verses.text:
अष्टावष्टगवान्यूहुः शकटानि यदायुधम् ।
अह्नस्तदष्टभागेन द्रौणिश्चिक्षेप मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Eight carts drawn by eight oxen each carry as many weapons as Drona's son shot, O lord, in an eighth part of the day.

verses.text:
तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धमन्तकालान्तकोपमम् ।
ये ये ददृशिरे तत्र विसंज्ञाः प्रायशोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever there saw him, like angry Death, like the ender of the end of time, was mostly left senseless.

verses.text:
पर्जन्य इव घर्मान्ते वृष्ट्या साद्रिद्रुमां महीम् ।
आचार्यपुत्रस्तां सेनां बाणवृष्ट्याभ्यवीवृषत् ॥

meaning.en: Like Parjanya at the end of the hot season showering the earth with its mountains and trees, the teacher's son rained that army with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
द्रौणिपर्जन्यमुक्तां तां बाणवृष्टिं सुदुःसहाम् ।
वायव्यास्त्रेण स क्षिप्रं रुद्ध्वा पाण्ड्यानिलोऽनदत् ॥

meaning.en: The unbearable shower of arrows released by the rain-god Drona's son, the Pandya, a wind, quickly stopped with the Vayavya weapon and roared.

verses.text:
तस्य नानदतः केतुं चन्दनागुरुभूषितम् ।
मलयप्रतिमं द्रौणिश्छित्त्वाश्वांश्चतुरोऽहनत् ॥

meaning.en: As he roared, Drona's son cut his banner adorned with sandal and aloe, like the Malaya mountain, and killed his four horses.

verses.text:
सूतमेकेषुणा हत्वा महाजलदनिस्वनम् ।
धनुश्छित्त्वार्धचन्द्रेण व्यधमत्तिलशो रथम् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed his charioteer with one arrow, with a sound like a great cloud, and cut his bow with a half-moon arrow, he broke the chariot to bits.

verses.text:
अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य छित्त्वा सर्वायुधानि च ।
प्राप्तमप्यहितं द्रौणिर्न जघान रणेप्सया ॥

meaning.en: Parrying his weapons with weapons and cutting all his arms, Drona's son did not kill the enemy though he was at hand, wanting to fight on.

verses.text:
हतेश्वरो दन्तिवरः सुकल्पित-
स्त्वराभिसृष्टः प्रतिशर्मगो बली ।
तमध्यतिष्ठन्मलयेश्वरो महा-
न्यथाद्रिशृङ्गं हरिरुन्नदंस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Mounting a fine elephant whose master had been killed, well equipped and quickly driven, strong and trained to charge, the great lord of Malaya roared like a lion on a mountain peak.

verses.text:
स तोमरं भास्कररश्मिसंनिभं
बलास्त्रसर्गोत्तमयत्नमन्युभिः ।
ससर्ज शीघ्रं प्रतिपीडयन्गजं
गुरोः सुतायाद्रिपतीश्वरो नदन् ॥

meaning.en: Pressing the elephant forward, roaring, that lord of mountains hurled swiftly at the teacher's son a lance like the sun's rays, with the supreme effort and anger of his strength and weapon.

verses.text:
मणिप्रतानोत्तमवज्रहाटकै-
रलंकृतं चांशुकमाल्यमौक्तिकैः ।
हतोऽस्यसावित्यसकृन्मुदा नद-
न्पराभिनद्द्रौणिवराङ्गभूषणम् ॥

meaning.en: With great joy, shouting again and again, "He is killed!", he struck Drona's son's crown ornament, set with jewel strands, the best diamonds and gold, adorned with silks, garlands and pearls.

verses.text:
तदर्कचन्द्रग्रहपावकत्विषं
भृशाभिघातात्पतितं विचूर्णितम् ।
महेन्द्रवज्राभिहतं महावनं
यथाद्रिशृङ्गं धरणीतले तथा ॥

meaning.en: That crown, bright like sun, moon, planets and fire, fell shattered by the heavy blow, like a mountain peak struck by Mahendra's thunderbolt in a great forest, to the earth.

verses.text:
ततः प्रजज्वाल परेण मन्युना
पदाहतो नागपतिर्यथा तथा ।
समादधे चान्तकदण्डसंनिभा-
निषूनमित्रान्तकरांश्चतुर्दश ॥

meaning.en: Then he blazed with extreme anger, like a king of serpents struck by a foot, and fitted fourteen arrows like Death's rod, slayers of enemies.

verses.text:
द्विपस्य पादाग्रकरान्स पञ्चभि-
र्नृपस्य बाहू च शिरोऽथ च त्रिभिः ।
जघान षड्भिः षडृतूत्तमत्विषः
स पाण्ड्यराजानुचरान्महारथान् ॥

meaning.en: With five he killed the elephant's feet and trunk, with three the king's arms and head, and with six the Pandya king's six great chariot-fighter followers, who had the splendour of the six seasons.

verses.text:
सुदीर्घवृत्तौ वरचन्दनोक्षितौ
सुवर्णमुक्तामणिवज्रभूषितौ ।
भुजौ धरायां पतितौ नृपस्य तौ
विवेष्टतुस्तार्क्ष्यहताविवोरगौ ॥

meaning.en: The king's two arms, long and rounded, smeared with fine sandal, adorned with gold, pearls, gems and diamonds, fell to the ground and writhed like serpents struck by Garuda.

verses.text:
शिरश्च तत्पूर्णशशिप्रभाननं
सरोषताम्रायतनेत्रमुन्नसम् ।
क्षितौ विबभ्राज पतत्सकुण्डलं
विशाखयोर्मध्यगतः शशी यथा ॥

meaning.en: And that head, with a face bright as the full moon, long red eyes, high nose and earrings, fell shining on the ground like the moon between the two Vishakha stars.

verses.text:
समाप्तविद्यं तु गुरोः सुतं नृपः
समाप्तकर्माणमुपेत्य ते सुतः ।
सुहृद्वृतोऽत्यर्थमपूजयन्मुदा
जिते बलौ विष्णुमिवामरेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by friends, your son joyfully honoured the teacher's son who had completed his learning and deed, as the lord of the immortals honoured Vishnu when Bali was conquered.
